text: It is often claimed that juries get too many decisions wrong.
Explain the role of both civil and criminal juries and assess the validity of the statement above.
Discuss the contribution of Equity to the legal system today. [25]
Explain the composition and work of tribunals. Assess the advantages and disadvantages of the
tribunal system. [25]
The creation of the Human Rights Act 1998 has been considered an important step in the
protection of the rights of individuals.
Explain the rights protected by this legislation and assess the extent to which it has been
successful. [25]
Explain the sentences available to the court following the conviction of a young offender for a
serious offence. Justify which of the aims of sentencing a court might wish to achieve in this
instance. [25]
Explain the training and role of a solicitor. Discuss the problems that might be faced by someone
intending to enter this profession. [25]
